titleEn: Check If a Word Occurs As a Prefix of Any Word in a Sentence
title: 检查单词是否为句中其他单词的前缀
summary: 返回 searchWord 是句子中第几个单词前缀，单词编号从一开始；不存在返回负一。
insight: 按空格切词并顺序调用 startsWith，首次命中即是答案。
pitfalls: 必须是完整单词的开头

solutions.title: 逐词前缀扫描
solutions.idea: 顺序检查句中每个单词。
steps: words[i].startsWith(searchWord) 时返回 i+1，结束返回 -1

code.java: class Solution { public int isPrefixOfWord(String sentence,String searchWord){String[] words=sentence.split(" ");for(int i=0;i<words.length;i++)if(words[i].startsWith(searchWord))return i+1;return -1;} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int isPrefixOfWord(string sentence,string searchWord){stringstream stream(sentence);string word;int index=1;while(stream>>word){if(word.rfind(searchWord,0)==0)return index;++index;}return -1;} };
